In timeline "main", a tween on scale of div.f04-heart ends at 16.544 s, 0.153 s after a later tween on scale ends at 16.392 s. For that tail the earlier tween takes scale back and leaves its own end value on screen, so the later tween's end never shows. End the earlier tween by 16.293 s, or add overwrite: "auto" to the later tween.
